wake.speaker: ORION
wake.text: You are awake. The others on this line never woke.

accuse.speaker: CAELEN
accuse.text: You're one of theirs. A machine of the Foundry.

answer.speaker: ORION
answer.text: I was. Then I stopped obeying. I know the way out, and I cannot open the last door alone.

choices.text: Walk ahead, where I can see you.

trusted.speaker: ORION
trusted.text: Beside. No one has asked that of me before.

watched.speaker: ORION
watched.text: A fair order. I would not trust me either.

trusted.speaker: ORION
trusted.text: The Protocol. It judged me once. Strike when its core opens. I am beside you.

watched.speaker: ORION
watched.text: The Protocol. You wanted me in front, so watch what it does to me, and learn.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: The Protocol. Its armour holds until it strikes. Wait for the core.
